thorn_bramble.desc: Copper-orange thorny brambles/roots sprout from the ground and spread (earth/nature trap)

thorn_bramble_b.desc: Variant of thorn_bramble with slightly different growth shapes

arcane_splash.desc: Magenta arcane blob bursts and scatters into droplets that fade (frame 0 is empty: a 1-frame delay)

void_sigil_ring.desc: Dark violet ring with 8 purple crystal spikes pulsing outward - curse/summon sigil, loopable

light_beam_h.desc: Horizontal white-gold energy beam: muzzle flash, thick beam spanning full frame width, then thinning out

fire_bolt.desc: Small orange fireball projectile travelling right with ember trail, loopable

fire_bolt_impact.desc: White flash pop breaking into an orange/red ember ring - projectile hit

heart_charm.desc: Small red-to-purple hearts float and flicker - charm/heal/buff

flame_flicker.desc: Small white-hot flame with orange tips burning on the ground (torch/candle/burning status), loopable

flame_splash_ground.desc: Flame drops and splashes into a crown of white petals that scatter - fire landing

stone_spikes.desc: Steel-blue stone spikes erupt diagonally from the ground (earth spike trap)

smoke_poof.desc: Big white smoke puff that breaks into scattered droplets and dissipates - teleport/vanish/death poof

heal_glyph_ground.desc: Thin green glyph line along the ground with rising pixel sparks - healing/regeneration field (matches green plus-sign Icon_08), loopable
